title: Decision 2026-06-02 AP Cut-off
summary: Decision shifting the accounts payable period-end cut-off to working day two at 12:00 from June 2026 onwards.
body:
This decision moves the monthly Accounts Payable processing cut-off forward to working day two at 12:00 starting from the June 2026 period close, enabling reporting to the board a day earlier [^r5]. All supplier invoices arriving after this deadline are deferred and posted into the subsequent financial period [^r6]. The operational shift overrides the previous timetable in [[sop-ap-002|SOP-AP-002]] while the formal procedure document awaits update [^r7].

## Details

Effective from the June 2026 close, the Accounts Payable cut-off takes place on working day two at 12:00 rather than working day three [^r5]. Financial Controller [[user-gwhitaker|Grace Whitaker]] confirmed that invoices received past this cut-off are deferred into the next period, noting that [[sop-ap-002|SOP-AP-002]] would be formally reissued when time permits [^r6][^r7].

The initial period close under the revised schedule completed successfully, allowing the purchase ledger to balance and post without earlier delays [^r1]. Late postal invoices arriving after the cut-off must be held over to the following period and require an accrual entry agreed with the financial controller [^r2]. Goods receiving delivery notes at the Leeds unit must be forwarded to accounts payable by the agreed morning deadline [^r4]. In addition, all component scrap sheets must be entered into the system prior to the end of the shift preceding the cut-off to prevent discrepancies between physical stock and perpetual inventory [^r3].

## Versions and conflicts

* **Today's rule:** The accounts payable cut-off occurs on working day two at 12:00, with later invoices deferred to the next period [^r5][^r6].
* **Older rule:** Accounts payable cut-off took place on working day three under [[sop-ap-002|SOP-AP-002]] [^r5].
* **Sources and dates:** E-mail regarding [[sop-ap-002|SOP-AP-002]] (2026-06-02) and Month-end review meeting notes (2026-06-30) override earlier documentation [^r1][^r5][^r7].
* **Kind:** email_overrides_sop [^r5][^r7].

## See also

* [[sop-ap-002|SOP-AP-002 Accounts Payable Period Close]]
* [[user-gwhitaker|Grace Whitaker (GWHITAKER)]]

r1.quote: The meeting reviewed the first close under the revised timetable. It was noted that the first close with the AP cut-off on working day two went well

r2.quote: These had to be held over to the following period, which will require an accrual entry agreed with the financial controller.

r3.quote: Confirm with the production supervisors that all scrap sheets for damaged components are keyed into the system prior to the end of the shift preceding the cut-off.

r4.quote: Liaise with the goods receiving team at the Leeds unit to ensure all paper delivery notes are forwarded to accounts payable by the agreed morning deadline.

r5.quote: from the June 2026 close the AP cut-off moves from working day 3 to working day 2 at 12:00

r6.quote: Invoices received after the cut-off go to the next period.

r7.quote: I will update SOP-AP-002 when I have time.
